component.name: Salutations
component.summary: Lean mail for GNOME Online Accounts

description.p: Salutations reads and sends mail from the accounts you have already added in GNOME Online Accounts, with nothing else to set up.
It is made for phones as much as desktops, with an adaptive layout and touch gestures throughout.

ul.li: Remote content is blocked until you allow it, then loads without cookies
Basic tracking can be removed from remote content
Links are checked before they open
Forged senders are flagged, and verified senders show their logo
OpenPGP signing and encryption use your own GnuPG keys

screenshot.caption: A conversation on the desktop, in light and dark styles
The inbox and a message on a phone, in light and dark styles

ul.li: The app icon's envelopes are fanned out instead of stacked straight
The About dialog credits the developer
Accounts from GNOME Online Accounts, with folders, threads, search and offline reading
An adaptive layout with touch gestures, from phones to desktops
Remote content blocked by default, with optional removal of basic tracking
Link checks, forged-sender flags and verified sender logos
OpenPGP signing, encryption and decryption through GnuPG
Undoable actions that keep working while the server catches up
